description: Agent Uncertainty: submit the claims in one work product with the evidence they cite: each claim with its id, the claim as written, the confidence stated for it in percent, whether the answer or decision rests on it and the ids of the evidence items it cites; each evidence item with its id, where it comes from and the support it gives as recorded (strong, moderate, thin or none) and whether it bears on the claim directly rather than by analogy; and optionally the highest confidence strong, moderate and thin support carry (95, 80 and 60 when left out, with no supporting evidence carrying at most 50). The signed report maps every claim to its cited evidence with its best support, indirect evidence counted one level lower, the ceiling that support carries and the margin between the stated confidence and that ceiling, lists every evidence item with the claims that cite it, and gives each claim as backed, exceeds_evidence, load_bearing_unsupported, load_bearing_thin, uncited, indirect_only or unconfirmed, and names confidence that outruns the evidence: claims stating more confidence than their cited evidence supports, load-bearing claims resting on no evidence, and load-bearing claims resting on thin evidence only; then other claims citing no evidence and claims resting only on indirect evidence, with the fix for each. The support each item gives is taken as recorded and the sources are not graded: marking each part of a claim supported or contradicted by evidence text is wever_claim-evidence-check, verifying a data sample field by field is wever_data-evidence-check, and whether a cited passage makes a claim is wever_knowledge-grounding-check. Verdict confidence_outruns_evidence, evidence_backing_gaps, evidence_backing_unverified or confidence_backed_by_evidence. POST /api/uncertainty-evidence-gap-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.
